text:
ciara: Heads-up — we plan to push a small runtime patch to eu-dedicated tonight at 00:30 UTC. This is a rolling update (per-pool restarts). Expect brief interruptions (1–2m) for a small fraction of requests. Preparing status page copy + a targeted customer email. Any objections to proceeding?

sam: I'm on-call for the window. No blockers from infra, but what's our rollback trigger and steps if latency or errors spike?

ciara: Rollback plan: pin to previous runtime image `v3.4.8`. Flow: canary -> staged -> full. Trigger: canary p95 > baseline p95 by 20% or error rate > 1%. If triggered, pause rollout and roll back canary hosts immediately. Ops runbook: we run `deploy rollback --image v3.4.8 --scope canary` then monitor for 15m.

matt: Customers asked for the exact maintenance window copy. Can we make the status page wording explicit (mins of intermittent latency, ETA window) so support gets fewer tickets?

ciara: Agreed. Draft below. @statuspage-bot can you stage this as an upcoming incident draft? Also we'll queue a targeted email to Dedicated customers 1h before start.

statuspage-bot: Staged draft: "Planned maintenance: rolling runtime update in EU Dedicated clusters. During restarts some requests may see brief latency increases or transient errors (typically 0–2 minutes per host). Expected window: 00:30 — 01:30 UTC. We will post updates here and follow up when the rollout completes." :bell:

deploy-bot: Release started: deploy-id=rb-202403; canary hosts 2/10 updated; health checks running; next status in ~6m.

sam: Canary metrics: error rate 0.8% (above baseline 0.2%), p95 latency +30% vs baseline. Pausing rollout and initiating rollback to v3.4.8.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: target-image=v3.4.8; rolling to canary hosts now. Notifying status page and queued email canceled.

ciara: Draft customer-facing status update (send after rollback starts):
```
Status update: We have paused a planned runtime update after observing increased latency in canary hosts. We are rolling back to the previous runtime image to minimize customer impact. Affected: EU Dedicated clusters only. Likely impact: brief request latency and transient errors while rollback completes. Estimated time to resolution: ~20 minutes. We will post another update when the rollback finishes.
```

matt: LGTM. I'll send proactive outreach to the top 10 affected accounts and CC support.

ciara: Thanks — once rollback completes we'll post the resolution on the status page and follow up with a short postmortem note outlining the trigger, root cause hypothesis, and next steps (hardening canary thresholds + a more conservative rollout throttle).
